name: positive-tx-in-anchor-parent
description: Captured XRPL mainnet proof of a transaction in the anchor ledger's parent (spec section 6, distance 1): anchor, ledger_header, ledger_header, map_proof(tx). The anchor header's parent_hash supports the target header; no skip list is involved. Binary form produced by the C++ encoder (xprv convert); intermediates derived independently by the Python verifier's primitives.

provenance.note: intermediates derived independently of the C++ encoder; the C++ gtest must reproduce them
